system.description: You overwrite the mind of a creature within 30' with the raw, violent will of the void.

outcomes.success: The creature takes 2d10 damage and becomes a Dark Vessel until the end of the encounter. It gains d8 HP and, each turn, attacks the target you choose by the most effective means.
outcomes.ruin: The void looks back at you through it: it becomes a Dark Vessel that attacks only you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
